MillsChat, a private internal generative AI assistant for employees (writing, summarizing, brainstorming, building AI skills), scaled from a 900-person pilot to ~20,000 employees across non-plant locations in the US, Canada, UK and India. [Google Cloud (PaLM 2 / Vertex AI)]

Generative AI in procurement using enhanced datasets to build models that identify the gap between what General Mills currently pays and market/should-cost benchmarks, informing supplier negotiations and cost reduction.

Digital personas and AI-moderated consumer research: conversational AI chatbots conduct hundreds of consumer interviews overnight to build digital buyer personas and inform new product development and innovation.

AI-powered personalized consumer marketing: using past-purchase data and AI to tailor emails and ads and automate marketer workflows across channels at scale. [Salesforce (Marketing Cloud / Einstein AI)]

E-commerce AI 'scanner' engine that analyzes search performance, assortment, content and consumer reviews across digital retailers to optimize online sales; being scaled globally and enhanced with generative and agentic AI.

Enterprise generative AI / LLM access built on BigQuery and Vertex AI giving employees secure access to generative models to answer questions on internal data; part of full cloud migration of all company data to Google Cloud. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Looker, Apigee)]

Project Elf, an intelligent supply-chain execution / logistics-automation layer using generative and agentic AI to plan and auto-approve daily shipments (over 5,000 plant-to-warehouse shipments assessed daily) without a human approval loop, moving from an 'episodic' to 'always-on' supply chain. [Palantir (Foundry / AIP)]

Machine learning models on manufacturing production lines that predict waste and optimize throughput, reducing downtime and improving yields.
